definition_title: Complex logarithm truncation tail and series identities
natural_language_statement: For T : ℕ and z : ℂ, logTail T z is Complex.logTaylor T z − Complex.log (1 + z). The bundle also identifies the convergent power-series coefficient sum for Complex.log (1 + z) when ‖z‖ < 1, and gives general HasSum rules for coefficients of products, the constant series 1, and powers of a power series.
explanation: This provider packages the finite Taylor-logarithm remainder used alongside the source’s power-series calculations. Its public results relate the logarithm series coefficients to the complex logarithm on the unit disk and propagate coefficient-sum identities through multiplication and natural powers.
